title: Jupiter Great Red Spot & Galilean Moons Transit
notes: Clear viewing with 8-inch Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope. Great Red Spot prominent near Central Meridian. Io and Europa observed transiting across the southern equatorial belt.

title: Andromeda Galaxy (M31) Spiral Arms & Core
notes: Captured 45-minute stacked exposure using dual narrowband filter. Dust lanes clearly resolved alongside companion satellite galaxy M32.

title: ISS Evening Twilight Pass & Solar Array Flare
notes: Magnitude -3.8 high elevation pass across zenith. Spectacular specular flash observed as solar arrays caught low sunset angle.

title: Sunspot Complex AR3664 & X-Class Flare Ejection
notes: Observed via Hydrogen-Alpha solar scope with Baader solar filter. Extreme coronal mass ejection magnetic filament loop visible off southwest limb.

title: TRAPPIST-1e Habitable Zone Transit Anomaly
notes: Photometric dip matching predicted transit ephemeris. Light curve analysis indicates atmospheric attenuation consistent with water vapor signature.
